text.p: Micronics Computers Inc said it expects a net loss for the quarter ended March 31, 1997 of between $2.7 million to $3.2 million or $0.19 to $0.23 a share on net revenue of between $24 million to $25 million.
In the year-ago quarter, Micronics reported revenue of $40.7 million and a net loss of $916,000,

The company said the second quarter revenue shortfall is expected to be due principally to lower sales to Original Equipment Manufacturers and government markets, unanticipated returns by distributors and delays related to supplier inability to provide component parts.
Micronics said it had expected sales to remain relatively flat from the previous quarter.
The expected net loss is a result of the lower level of sales and lower gross margins on certain products due to competition and unexpected product returns, the company said.
